title: Bell EQ
summary: Raise or lower a band around a centre frequency, smoothly: a raised cosine in octaves, the full gain at the centre and half of it half a width away. Static and zero-phase.

params.title: Gain
params.help: Positive raises the band, negative lowers it.

params.title: Width
params.help: Between the points where the gain is half; the band ends a whole width either side of the centre.
